final: WITH base AS (SELECT ili.order_item_id, p.product_color AS color, CAST(ili.product_quantity AS REAL) AS units, CASE WHEN ili.derived_product_cost IS NOT NULL AND ili.derived_total_cost IS NOT NULL AND ili.derived_total_cost <> 0 THEN (ili.derived_product_cost - ili.derived_total_cost) * 1.0 / ili.derived_total_cost END AS ratio FROM Invoice_Line_Items ili JOIN Order_Items oi ON oi.order_item_id = ili.order_item_id JOIN Products p ON p.product_id = oi.product_id), g AS (SELECT order_item_id, color, AVG(units) AS avg_units, AVG(ratio) AS avg_ratio FROM base GROUP BY order_item_id, color), r AS (SELECT order_item_id, color, avg_units, avg_ratio, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY color ORDER BY (avg_units IS NULL), avg_units DESC) AS rnk FROM g) SELECT order_item_id, color, avg_units, avg_ratio, rnk FROM r WHERE rnk <= 3 ORDER BY color, rnk, order_item_id
